pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, main subject in the middle of the frame, no text or letters, no logos. Inside a tiny one-room wooden house in an old eastern European village, with a clay stove, a single table and benches, lit by a single oil lamp: a poor village man in his forties with a dark beard, a flat wool cap and a patched brown coat, his wife in a faded red head scarf, his grey-haired mother knitting, and a crowd of cheerful children squeezed together, bumping elbows at the table, a baby on a lap.
